methodology: 12 root-authored held-out questions frozen before retrieval evaluation; single original corpus snapshot, top5 indexed chunks, designated physical PDF page anchors. BM25, local TF-IDF/SVD and equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion(k60). No question labels used in model fitting and no held-out tuning.
limitations: Page-anchor relevance is incomplete and overlapping chunks can repeat pages. Hit@5 and MRR are against designated pages, not exhaustive relevance judgments. One small English institutional corpus; no general superiority claim. First latent query includes index fitting; sequential timings are observations, not a controlled benchmark.

freeze.policy: No held-out-specific ranking/prompt tuning. Report all cases and baselines; any subsequent retune requires a new heldout set.

live.note: Recorded live-model evaluation is documented in VERIFICATION.md; no model calls are part of bootstrap.
